note: A beginning, not a record: two instruments to show the shape. confidence `recalled` = written from knowledge with a citation, nothing opened.

confidence_tiers.recalled: written from knowledge, with a citation; nothing opened
confidence_tiers.cited: the citation resolved to an act of that name and date at the publisher
confidence_tiers.read: the source text was read and the summary checked against it

instruments.title: State of emergency for drought in the Po basin
instruments.citation: Delibera del Consiglio dei Ministri, 4 luglio 2022 — stato di emergenza per deficit idrico (Emilia-Romagna, Friuli Venezia Giulia, Lombardia, Piemonte, Veneto)
instruments.summary: Declared after the driest winter and spring in seventy years on the Po; €36.5m of first relief, water rationing in the plain, salt-water intrusion to 30 km up the delta.

instruments.title: Drought decree — a national water commissioner
instruments.citation: Decreto-legge 14 aprile 2023, n. 39 (converted by Legge 13 giugno 2023, n. 68)
instruments.summary: Creates a control room and an extraordinary commissioner for water scarcity, simplifies authorisation of reservoirs, reuse and desalination.
